newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grain tenders cover 2.5 million tonnes. [CORRECTED 17:13 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EU grain tenders cover 2.5 million tonnes. [CORRECTED 17:13 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects the figure in the headline to 2.5 million from three million.)

European Union grain export tenders adopted on Thursday will cover a nominal volume of one million tonnes each for wheat and barley and 500,000 tonnes for rye, grain officials said (corrects amount for rye).
The figures -- to be contained in the EU's official publications -- are regarded as nominal since they can and will be changed during the course of the July/June season, they said.
